$comment: Character rules of Georgian and English content fields (spec 00 R-5.3a P-136, R-5.4; spec 04 AC-5, AC-6; spec 10 AC-3, AC-4). One file read by the API validator and by the web/mobile pre-checks. Ranges are inclusive Unicode code points.

normalise.$comment: Before checking: remove formatting markup, decode HTML entities, turn these into a normal space, trim (legacy GeorgianTextOnly.php:11-14).

georgianField.$comment: Every character must be in one of these ranges; at least one Georgian letter is required (P-37).

englishField.$comment: No Georgian letter and at least one Latin letter (legacy EnglishTextOnly.php:20-24).
